text: dsh-git 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 Git 插件，会在聊天输入框旁显示仓库与分支状态，并在会话标题栏和侧边栏提供 Git 面板。用户可以查看工作区改动和文件差异、暂存或取消暂存文件、填写提交信息并创建提交，也能浏览提交历史、筛选记录、查看提交差异和切换分支。面板支持通过 DSH 默认模型生成提交信息。适合希望在 DSH 中直接处理项目 Git 状态与提交的开发者。需要本机可调用 git 命令；生成提交信息时使用 Harness 的模型服务。

dsh-git adds Git controls to the DSH web client: a repository and branch indicator, plus a sidebar panel for changes, diffs, staging, commits, history, and branch switching. It can draft a commit message with the Harness model service. Requires a local git command.
想在 DSH 里直接查看当前项目的 Git 分支和改动。
能不能在聊天界面暂存文件、写提交说明并完成 Git 提交？
I want to browse commit history and inspect file diffs without leaving my DSH workspace.
dsh-git 的功能「仓库状态与差异面板」：在聊天输入框和会话标题栏提供入口，并在侧栏展示仓库分支、文件改动、提交历史和所选文件的 diff。
dsh-git 的功能「暂存与提交」：在 Git 面板选择文件暂存或取消暂存，输入提交信息后创建提交，也可调用 Harness 模型根据改动草拟提交信息。

Git in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) composer and sidebar: a repo/branch chip, a header button, and a split Git panel with staging, commit, history and diffs.

@weidows/dsh-git README · What it adds：**1. Branch chip in the composer.** A small pill sits in the composer trailing cluster, left of the model picker and the session-stats control:

```
main-repo / feature/login   ↑2
```

It shows the repository name, the current branch, ahead/behind markers, and a dirty dot. Click it to open the Git panel.

**2. Git button in the conversation header.** The same action from the top-right utilities row of an open conversation.

**3. A split Git panel in the sidebar.**

@weidows/dsh-git README · What it adds：```
+----------------------+----------------------+
| changes + staging    | history              |
|  staged / unstaged   |  branch + filter     |
|  [ AI ] [ ] [commit] |  expandable commits  |

@weidows/dsh-git README · What it adds：**Narrow screens.** Below 720px the two-column grid collapses into one stacked column (changes, history, diff), panes keep their own scroll with sensible max heights, tap targets grow, the short hash hides, the filter box moves to its own row, and per-file actions stay visible on touch devices where there is no hover.

text: @weidows/dsh-git README · dsh-better-sidebar：[dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) is supported and preferred when installed. dsh-git registers its panel through `ctx.betterSidebar.registerTab` (order 25, single instance) and skips its own native right-sidebar tab, so you never end up with two Git tabs. Without better-sidebar it falls back to a plain right-sidebar tab.

@weidows/dsh-git README · dsh-better-sidebar：better-sidebar mirrors native tab kinds into its own registry, so registering a native kind and a better-sidebar tab under the same id makes its bridge throw `tab kind "..." is already registered`. The two registrations therefore use separate, author-tagged ids — `dsh-git-by-weidows` (better-sidebar tab) and `dsh-git-native-by-weidows` (native kind) — and the native kind is never registered while the service is present. Both carry a full description for the new-tab list: repo and branch status, changes and staging, commits, history and diffs.

@weidows/dsh-git README · dsh-better-sidebar：The panel can also be opened by other plugins:

```js
ctx.betterSidebar.openTab({ type: "dsh-git-by-weidows", title: "Git by@Weidows", meta: { cwd } }, { sessionId })
```

@weidows/dsh-git README · Host API：All traffic goes through `POST /plugins/dsh-git/api/<method>` with a JSON body and returns `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error: { message } }`. Requests are rejected with 403 unless they come from the Harness connection. Every git call is `execFile("git", argv)` — never a shell — with a validated working directory, pathspecs after `--`, and 24 MB output caps.

@weidows/dsh-git README · Host API：| method | body | returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | { cwd } | repo name, branch, ahead/behind, file list with per-file index/worktree state |
| `diff` | { cwd, mode: "worktree" or "staged", path? } | unified patch of the working tree, the index, or one file |
| `log` | { cwd, ref?, search?, limit? } | commits (hash, short, subject, author, date, refs) |
| `commit` | { cwd, hash } | commit meta, changed files with +/- counts, patch |
| `commit-files` | { cwd, hash } | files of a commit |
| `commit-file` | { cwd, hash, path } | patch of one file inside a commit |
| `stage` / `unstage` | { cwd, paths: [] } | fresh state |
| `discard` | { cwd, paths: [] } | fresh state (tracked files only) |
| `commit-create` | { cwd, message, all? } | fresh state |
| `branches` | { cwd } | local and remote branches |
| `checkout` | { cwd, branch } | fresh state |
| `reset` | { cwd, hash, mode: "soft", "mixed" or "hard" } | fresh state |
| `revert` | { cwd, hash } | fresh state |
| `suggest` | { cwd, sessionId?, language? } | AI commit message derived from the staged/working diff |

@weidows/dsh-git README · Safety：- `reset --hard`, `revert` and `discard` are destructive; they are only reachable from explicit clicks in the panel. A revert that hits a conflict is rolled back with `git revert --abort`, so the working tree is never left mid-merge.
- Discarding an untracked file is refused instead of deleting it, and untracked files never show the discard action in the panel.
- Pathspecs and branch names are validated (no leading `-`, no whitespace or `..` in branches) and passed after `--`.
- The plugin never runs a shell, never prompts for credentials (`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`), and never reads anything outside the session working directory.

@weidows/dsh-git README · Development：```
lib/index.js       host half: the /plugins/dsh-git/api route and all git + LLM work
lib/client.js      browser half: slots, chip, header button, panel, native + better-sidebar tabs
cordis.patch.yml   bundle patch that inserts the plugin into the profile
```

The client half is a plain Harness client plugin (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`) that registers React components into slots:
